minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 24, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers on the 9th floor
at 11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, City Treasurer
  Aisha Thomson, City Clerk Department

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes- Human Resources
  Micah Herd – Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of February 10, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Worxtime - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the services for
  year-end employee reporting and mailing of 1095 in the amount of $7,435.04. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  3. Monjaras & Wismeyer Group, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for services for facilitation Interactive Process Accommodation in the amount
  of $1,433.20.

  4. Enterprise Rent-A-Car – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  rental of vehicles for the Police Department the amount of $6,883.21. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:40 a.m. Adjournment
